rules: Entry rules and permits · Haridwar → Kedarnath
What a visitor may need on this trip. Tap a source to read it.
Char Dham yatra registration
Required

Registration for the Char Dham and Hemkund Sahib yatra is mandatory. You get a QR code. If you travel by your own vehicle, you upload its details. Register on the official Tourist Care Uttarakhand portal before you start.
Source: Tourist Care Uttarakhand, official FAQ
Vehicle papers and hill endorsement for Char Dham, 2026
Check

Reports on the 2026 yatra describe a Green Card and a per-trip Trip Card for passenger vehicles, checked by officers with handheld devices, a hill endorsement for every driver and limits on very long vehicles on narrow stretches. The papers differ for commercial and private vehicles and the reports are not official, so confirm on the state transport portal before you go.
Source: Trip to Temples, news report on the 2026 yatra · Outlook Traveller, Char Dham Yatra 2026 rules
The shrines close for winter
Check

Closing dates are announced each year on Vijayadashami. In 2025 Gangotri closed on 22 October, Kedarnath and Yamunotri on 23 October (Bhai Dooj) and Badrinath on 25 November. Expect a similar pattern after Diwali in 2026. Confirm the dates before you plan a trip in late October or November. Snow can also shut the roads beyond.
Source: All India Radio, 2 Oct 2025 · All India Radio, 25 Nov 2025
Hill-road driving endorsement
Check

Hill roads may need a hill endorsement on the driving licence. In 2023 Uttarakhand’s State Consumer Commission rejected an insurance claim for a hill accident because the driver’s licence had no hill endorsement. Ask your RTO or insurer whether your vehicle type needs one.
Source: LiveLaw · State Commission, case A/159/2022, 28 Aug 2023
Night driving on Char Dham roads
Good to know

Night travel on the Char Dham mountain roads is restricted. A state decision reported in May 2022 widened vehicle movement from the 05:00 to 20:00 window to 04:00 to 22:00. A report on the 2026 yatra says night travel is barred from 22:00 to 04:00 (another report says 20:00 to 05:00). PahaadPath plans hill stretches only between 05:00 and 19:00 because falling rock and sharp bends are harder to see after dark. Check local police notices.
Source: Daily Pioneer, 8 May 2022 · Outlook Traveller, Char Dham Yatra 2026 rules

Why they exist: crowds. On 5 June 2025 a visitor died in Mussoorie after his family took over an hour to cover less than 4 km to a medical facility in a jam. Registration and permit caps are meant to manage crowds and traffic.
Rules change often. Confirm on the official portal or with local police before you travel.
safety: Helplines
Emergency: police, fire, ambulance, disaster
Uttarakhand State Emergency Operation Centre
District Emergency Operation Centre (add the district code from outside)
Tourist Care Uttarakhand, yatra helpline
Numbers from the Uttarakhand disaster management authority site and the Tourist Care Uttarakhand portal. Check them before you travel. usdma.uk.gov.in · registrationandtouristcare.uk.gov.in
Send my location (SOS)
Call 112 or send your location by SMS. SMS often gets through where mobile data does not.
Towns with lodging on this road
Devprayag · Srinagar (Garhwal) · Rudraprayag · Guptkashi · Sonprayag · Gaurikund
If a landslide blocks the road
Stop well back from the debris. Do not try to cross a fresh slide or walk under a slope that is still moving.
Turn back to the last town with lodging if the road may stay shut for hours.
In heavy rain keep away from streams, culverts and the valley side of the road.
Tell the district control room on 1077 or call 112 with the place name or kilometre stone.
Keep fuel above half, carry water, warm clothes, a torch, medicines and some cash.
General safety advice, not an official instruction.
Official warnings
Needs internet. PahaadPath is advisory; these are the official sources.
Sachet (NDMA): official disaster alerts by district
IMD Mausam: district weather warnings
Fuel, hospitals and mechanics on this route
Mapped in OpenStreetMap within 3 km of each town (2026-10-31). Small hill towns are often missing, so ask locally too.
Longest stretch with no fuel station mapped: about 148 km, Devprayag to Gaurikund. Fill up in Devprayag.
Haridwar: hospital or clinic 3 (Ramkrishan Mission Hospital, Ramakrishna Mission Sevashrama, Haridwar) · ATM 3
reports: A report counts for 6 hours. Two or more confirmations mark a stretch as blocked. This prototype keeps reports on this phone only.

Reports go to a public test channel (ntfy.sh) so every phone running PahaadPath and the control room see them within seconds. Only the stretch, the type of problem and a random device code are sent. A production version would use an authenticated server.
